com.datastax.oss.driver.api.querybuilder.update

Interface Update

  • All Superinterfaces:
    BuildableQuery, ConditionalStatement<Update>, OngoingWhereClause<Update>

    public interface Update
extends OngoingWhereClause<Update>, ConditionalStatement<Update>, BuildableQuery
    A buildable UPDATE statement that has at least one assignment and one WHERE clause. You can keep adding WHERE clauses, or add IF conditions.
